purpose: Confirm channel mismatch, efficient matched-LiRA recovery, and practical low-FPR utility without post-hoc regime selection.

provenance.serving_description: Local Qiskit Aer circuit execution under one frozen IBM-derived ibm_kingston noise snapshot.

candidate_protocol.rationale: One thousand nonmembers place ten false positives at 1% FPR; one thousand members give 0.1 percentage-point TPR resolution. Simulator seeds are not counted as independent membership decisions.

serving_protocol.reference_oracle_cache_scope: one cache per structural cell and complete serving protocol

channel_lira.channel_fit: strict leave-target-out with attacked sample-ID fold excluded

learned_mia.access: membership-labeled cross-fitted outputs from the attacked target
learned_mia.claim_limit: Does not support claims against learned MIAs in general.

endpoint_hierarchy.confirmatory_subset: phase7_analysis_role=confirmatory only; the pilot cell is excluded

primary_endpoint.unit: target checkpoint after averaging simulator seeds
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: hierarchical bootstrap over structural cells and targets within cells

endpoint_hierarchy.multiplicity_rule: Only the frozen primary endpoint and comparison determine practical-attack success; secondary and exploratory results cannot replace a failed primary endpoint.

A_channel_mismatch.comparison: matched noisy LiRA minus mismatched LiRA
A_channel_mismatch.criterion: confirmatory hierarchical 95% interval lower bound is greater than zero at the primary endpoint

B_efficient_recovery.criterion: confirmatory hierarchical 95% interval lower bound exceeds the negative frozen margin and amortized noisy calibration-model cost is at most 25% of matched-reference cost

C_practical_attack.criterion: confirmatory hierarchical 95% interval lower bound is greater than zero for noisy 128-shot TPR@1% FPR

paper_decision.A_only: revise the channel model before an attack claim
paper_decision.A_fails: the core serving-mismatch motivation is not confirmed

cost_accounting.cost_interpretation: ChannelLiRA has nonzero auxiliary calibration cost; it eliminates noisy reference-model serving, not all noisy-model execution.

analysis_rules.simulator_seed_handling: Average simulator seeds within each target before target/cell inference.
analysis_rules.pilot_handling: Report the Phase-6 cell and Phase-7 pilot replication separately; never include them in the confirmatory primary interval.
analysis_rules.candidate_dependence: Do not treat repeated simulator realizations as independent records.
analysis_rules.claim_scope: No claim of real-hardware leakage, universal MIA superiority, stable 0.1% FPR, or superiority over learned MIAs generally.
analysis_rules.method_changes_after_freeze: Any method or endpoint change requires a new protocol version and makes the changed analysis exploratory.

execution_stages.name: confirmatory_primary
execution_stages.rule: Complete and hash all outputs before unblinding aggregate attack comparisons.

execution_stages.name: frozen_secondary_conditions
execution_stages.conditions: secondary noisy and ideal diagnostic conditions
